Tara: Heads-up: Partner 'SkyLoom' reported missing usage for customers that replayed compacted files older than 10 days. They expected us to accept 30d replays.
Ethan: our current replay window is 7 days by policy. Did we communicate that?
Tara: onboarding docs say 7d but partner claims their retention changed after onboarding. They sent example manifest showing 18d files.
Luis: agreed policy-wise we need a clear surface: either partners retain raw events 30d or include absolute snapshots in compaction. Short-term: accept ad-hoc 18d replays for SkyLoom as a one-off with signed manifest and manual QA.
Ethan: operational constraints: accepting older replays risks ledger conflicts. We should require replay manifests that include: list of event_ids, counts, and HMAC per-file. Also mark any applied backfill with invoice flag "manual_backfill" so billing knows not to auto-issue credits.
Tara: smart. billing-bot can you list customer_ids affected by SkyLoom replays in last 45 days?
billing-bot: Query queued: SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM marketplace_usage WHERE partner='skyloom' AND received_at >= '2026-01-20' AND replay_flag = true; estimated rows: 23
Luis: next steps: 1) Partnerships to approve one-off acceptance and notify finance; 2) Eng to add manifest + HMAC validation and set backfill invoice flag; 3) Ops to run manual QA before applying. I'll draft the short-term acceptance note and retention amendment for onboarding checklist.
Ethan: timeline? can we have the manifest validation deployed tomorrow behind a feature flag?
Luis: yes, will push PR today and gate with partnerships.hotfix.skyloom_replay.
Tara: I'll send partner note outlining required manifest fields and that future acceptance >7d will require contract amendment. Thanks all.
